courses.subject: ARCH
courses.title: Internship in Archaeology
courses.description: Permission of the instructor and the director of undergraduate studies. Internships combine substantive work experience with an academic project.
courses.repeat_rules: May be repeated for credit. 12 total credits. 2 total completions.

courses.subject: ARCH
courses.title: Research in Archaeology
courses.description: Permission of the instructor. For students who wish to participate in laboratory or field research programs. May be taken twice.
courses.repeat_rules: May be repeated for credit. 12 total credits. 2 total completions.

courses.subject: ARCH
courses.title: Independent Study in Archaeology
courses.description: Permission of the instructor. Special reading and research in archaeology under the supervision of a selected instructor. May be taken twice.
courses.repeat_rules: May be repeated for credit. 12 total credits. 2 total completions.

courses.subject: ARCH
courses.title: Seniors Honors Thesis, Part 1
courses.description: First semester of senior honors thesis. Independent research under the direction of an archaeology curriculum faculty member. Permission of the instructor. Restricted to senior honors candidates.

courses.subject: ARCH
courses.title: Senior Honors Thesis, Part 2
courses.description: Second semester of senior honors thesis. Independent research under the direction of an archaeology curriculum faculty member. Permission of the instructor. Restricted to senior honors candidates.
